verdict.rationale: SCIM provisioning and deprovisioning is a fair question for an auth product, but the evidence pack never mentions SCIM, directory sync, or IdP-driven deprovisioning. The only nearby evidence is SAML 2.0 SSO and user-management APIs, which are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can sync users and groups from customer directories via SCIM so deprovisioning in the IdP revokes app access
